result.brief: 提出 3D 原生的世界动作模型 UNITAS，用统一度量 3D 表征与轨迹 tokenizer 联合建模动作与场景动力学。
result.reason: 3D-native world action model with world-aligned positional embeddings and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer; contributes a shared metric 3D representation for action-conditioned scene prediction, though framed as embodied manipulation.
